problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI Odom seq 07 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the InTEn-LOAM reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE)?

variants.label: InTEn-LOAM, dense profile
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).

variants.label: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline + 0.2 deg correction
variants.intent: FEF on the range image (ground lines, angle-based clusters, curvature and intensity features), S2S with re-association every iteration (Alg. 1), S2M on a temporal-voxel-filtered keyframe map (Alg. 2), DOR gating map insertion, cubic B-spline intensity residual, and the 0.2 deg KITTI correction the paper applies (Sec. 4.2.1).

variants.label: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline without the correction
InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline without the intensity residual
InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline, S2S only
variants.intent: S2M, TVF map and DOR off.

variants.label: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline, 0.05 m S2M plane check + 0.17 deg correction
variants.intent: As paper_odometry, but an S2M plane needs all 5 map neighbours within 0.05 m of the fitted plane (0.2 m before) and the correction is 0.17 deg (pitch error per frame is zero near 0.16 deg). Both values were chosen on seq 07 windows; the plane check was found while diagnosing the held-out 00 window 4000-4399, so 00 is not fully held out.
